rule: PASS a parameter if (a) all solves converge (MVIS ok, finite, each noisy reprojection RMS <= 1.5 x the reference's median noisy reprojection, noise-free reprojection < 0.05 px), (b) noise-free |err| <= max(1 sigma_good, floor), (c) |err|/sigma > 3 on fewer than 2 of the 3 noise seeds and > 4 on none, (d) sigma <= 3 x sigma_good, raw (the variant's own sigma against the 80 s reference's; no duration match, no sqrt(T) scaling; frame count reported only). GOOD if every parameter passes. sigma = median of the noise seeds' formal sigmas.
rotation: R_CI error as log(R) rotation vector, cam axes, mrad (never RPY)
duration_rule: none: rule (d) compares raw sigma with the reference's; n_frames is information
